problem: Solve the inequality  ${x}^{2}\ge 25$ using a graphical method.
worked_solution:
Bringing all the terms to the left-hand side, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2} & \ge 25 \\ {x}^{2}-25 & \ge 0.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we consider the corresponding parabola given by $\,y={x}^{2}-25\,$ and find its roots:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-25 & =0 \\ {x}^{2}-{5}^{2} & =0 \\ (x-5)(x+5) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

So the roots are $x=\pm 5.$ 

Solving the inequality ${x}^{2}-25\ge 0$ is equivalent to finding the values of $x$ for which the parabola $y={x}^{2}-25$ is above or intersects the $x$-axis (where $y\ge 0$).

Since the leading coefficient of the quadratic expression is positive, the parabola opens upward. Therefore, the solution set lies outside the roots (including them), as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13965374/assets/77c4caaa90dc3978ab6590885113a7e4ac0d155d3c2082166ab91c70603b0ea0.png)

Therefore, the solution is $x\in (-\infty ,-5]\cup [5,\infty ).$
